title: 401 endpoint publishes no protected-resource metadata at either well-known form
rationale: Both candidate locations must be probed before absence is declared. Probing only the root form manufactured failures for correctly configured servers, which is a denominator error that cannot be repaired after collection.

spec.quote: MCP servers MUST implement OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata (RFC9728). MCP clients MUST use OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata for authorization server discovery.
clients ... MUST fall back to constructing and requesting the well-known URIs in the order listed above

documents.comment: MCP's mandated fallback; absence only counts once both are tried
